description: This file defines data structures and parsing logic related to 'TalkDirective', including the 'TalkDirective' struct, its JSON parsing in 'TalkDirectiveParser', and the associated 'TalkDirectiveParseResult' structure. It provides functionality to parse a text input for directive configurations in JSON format to produce 'TalkDirective' instances.

classes.name: TalkDirective
classes.description: A data structure representing various parameters for speech synthesis or voice directives.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParseResult
classes.description: A structure containing the result of parsing a 'TalkDirective' from text, along with the stripped input and unknown keys.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an input string to extract a 'TalkDirective' from embedded JSON, returning a 'TalkDirectiveParseResult'.
